final_claim: For all nonempty idempotent frequency subsets H of Z/7, maximizing 2|R_H(1)|/sum_x|R_H(x)| gives the unique positive root of 97X^3+44X^2-20X-8, approximately 0.4402496918696975; equality exactly for the seven cyclic translates of {0,1,2}.
limitations: Only q=7, p=1 and nonzero target. For target 0 the concentration question is different; no general q formula.
